tasks.subject: Task 1: Promote BucketQueue::len() and add LightEngine::pending_ops_count()
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Expose queue depth from `LightEngine` so the call site in `app.rs` can read it without `#[cfg(test)]` restrictions.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/lighting/queue.rs` (remove `#[cfg(test)]` from `len()`)
- Modify: `src/lighting/engine.rs` (add `pending_ops_count()` + unit test)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `BucketQueue::len()` compiles in non-test builds
- [ ] `LightEngine::pending_ops_count()` returns sum of all pending work
- [ ] `pending_ops_count_reports_queue_depth` test passes
- [ ] `cargo test` 256+ tests pass
- [ ] `cargo clippy` clean

**Verify:** `cargo test pending_ops_count -- --nocapture` → 1 test passing

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lighting/queue.rs", "src/lighting/engine.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test pending_ops_count -- --nocapture", "acceptanceCriteria": ["BucketQueue::len() compiles without #[cfg(test)]", "pending_ops_count() sums all channel queue depths", "pending_ops_count_reports_queue_depth test passes", "cargo test all 256+ tests pass", "cargo clippy clean"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Dynamic budget in app.rs + PerfSnapshot::light_ops_pending
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the hardcoded 50k budget with a dynamic choice (500k during stream-in, 50k at rest) and track queue depth in `PerfSnapshot` for the HUD.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app.rs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `PerfSnapshot` has a `light_ops_pending: usize` field
- [ ] Budget is 500_000 when `chunks_pending > 100 || light_pending > 10_000`; 50_000 otherwise
- [ ] `perf.light_ops_pending` is set each frame to the pre-tick queue depth
- [ ] `cargo test` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy` clean

**Verify:** `cargo test && cargo clippy` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test && cargo clippy", "acceptanceCriteria": ["PerfSnapshot::light_ops_pending field exists", "budget 500_000 when chunks_pending > 100 or light_pending > 10_000", "budget 50_000 otherwise", "perf.light_ops_pending set per frame", "all tests pass", "clippy clean"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: HUD LO rename + profiler light_ops rename
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the always-zero legacy `LQ` HUD counter with `LO` (light ops pending) from `perf.light_ops_pending`; rename CSV field.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/render/hud.rs`
- Modify: `src/profiler.rs`
- Modify: `src/app.rs` (profiler flush call site)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] HUD shows `LO:` not `LQ:` on non-legacy builds
- [ ] `FrameCounters::light_ops` (not `light_queue`) in profiler.rs
- [ ] CSV header has `light_ops`
- [ ] Profiler flush uses `light_ops: self.perf.light_ops_pending as u32`
- [ ] `grep -r "light_queue" src/` only matches legacy-lighting path

**Verify:** `cargo test && cargo clippy && grep -r 'light_queue' src/`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/render/hud.rs", "src/profiler.rs", "src/app.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test && cargo clippy && grep -r 'light_queue' src/", "acceptanceCriteria": ["HUD shows LO: on default builds", "FrameCounters::light_ops field", "CSV header has light_ops", "profiler flush uses light_ops", "grep light_queue only legacy-lighting path"]}
```
